summary: E2E UI testing of Super Admin → Gestión de Usuarios (CRUD + password reset + activate/deactivate + search/filter + self-protection). All 9 requested flows PASS. Verified frontend UI + backend integration end-to-end. Test user created, fully exercised and cleaned up.

issues: CRA dev runtime-error overlay surfaces a benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning when interacting with Radix Select inside the Users tab (open Role/Plan dropdowns). It does NOT happen in production build, but during dev it blocks subsequent clicks until dismissed. Suggested fix: add a global error handler to suppress this specific message in /app/frontend/src/index.js (window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (e.message?.includes('ResizeObserver loop')) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true);). Low priority but worth doing because devs/QA hit it constantly.

action_items: (LOW) Suppress benign ResizeObserver loop warning in dev so CRA overlay doesn't block QA — add a one-line global handler in /app/frontend/src/index.js.

(NICE-TO-HAVE) /api/auth/login response does not include is_super_admin in the user payload (returned null in our run). UI works because /api/admin/* gates server-side, but adding the flag would let the client conditionally render Super Admin UI without an extra hierarchy call.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminUserManagement.js is clean and compact (~210 lines). Good use of data-testid across all interactive elements (users-new-btn, users-search, users-filter-role, users-filter-plan, user-row-{id}, user-edit/pw/status/delete-{id}, user-form-*, password-*).

Self-protection is enforced ONLY on the frontend (buttons hidden for own row). Backend already returns proper guards (validated by main agent via curl) so this is correct, but worth keeping aligned in code review.
Password reset dialog uses type='text' (line 203) — intentional so super admin can read & share the new password, but flag for security review if requirements change.
SuperAdminPage.js has multiple unused imports (Filter, BadgeCheck, AlertTriangle, FunnelChart, Funnel, LabelList, LineChart, Line) and unused 'scope' destructure — cosmetic cleanup.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin user management UI is fully functional. data-testids in AdminUserManagement.js are exhaustive and reliable. Be aware of CRA dev overlay (ResizeObserver) appearing after interacting with Radix Select inside the Users tab — dismiss it via the close X or call document.querySelectorAll('body > iframe').forEach(e=>e.remove()) before next click. In production build the overlay is absent. POST /api/auth/login returns 403 with detail 'Tu cuenta está desactivada. Contacta al administrador.' when active:false — UI shows 'INACTIVO' badge correctly. Own row hides user-status-{id} and user-delete-{id} buttons.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. The transient CRA dev overlay we encountered is a Radix UI / ResizeObserver known false-positive (browser dispatches an 'error' event whose message is just a perf warning; CRA's error-overlay listener catches it). Mitigation: a one-line listener in index.js suppresses it.
